_provenance.trimmed:
Each province file keeps the company entries named below and drops the other 60 to 650, which changes no behaviour: the parser reads one
/

pair at a time and holds no state across them. The MADRID file's entries are INVENTED in the bulletin's own format, and are the only invented text here; they carry the two-digit-year pivot, the backlog decline, the missing inscription date and the diacritics round trip, none of which happened to fall in the same real week.
_provenance.personal_data: BORME publishes a NAME and nothing else for these acts. The `personal_data_probe` document below invents a birth date, a DNI and a home address inside a real-shaped entry, so tests/test_spain_borme.py can prove that a bulletin that started publishing them could not reach a stored row without an edit to scrub_person.

why_these.BORME-A-2026-139-03: GONHER SA cancels and re-inscribes the same person at the SAME office (both halves must be declined); SPLA SA does it at a DIFFERENT office (both halves must survive).
why_these.BORME-A-2026-139-08: OLYMPUS IBERIA SA, a Revocaciones in ALLCAPS office spellings with a non-Spanish holder name.
why_these.BORME-A-2026-139-09: DISBUR SA re-elects its Con.Delegado in the same paragraph that ceases a Consejero — the re-election must be declined and counted while the cese, at an office this collector does not read, is simply not seen.
why_these.BORME-A-2026-139-30: AM FRESH CITRUS FARMING SL delegates to BLUEMED EXPERIENCES SL and BLACKROCK TECH&FIN INVESTMENTS SL — legal persons, declined.
why_these.BORME-A-2026-139-46: IDILIA FOODS SL, a real entry whose acts are ALL at offices this collector does not read. It is here so the run has a province file that contributes company entries and no events — the ordinary case, and the one a parser that silently matched too much would break.
why_these.BORME-A-2026-139-99: the alphabetical index, which is not a province and must never be counted as one.
